description.name: Entry
description.text:
Grants [Fire Damage +5%] to party, grants Master Mode, [Instant ATB 1], [Diffusion Barrier 1] to user
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 4, Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast 1
Interval Chase: 10 single-target Fire/NE hybrid attacks, Fire Damage +10/15/20/25/30% to party after 1/2/3/4/5 chases (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Fire/Holy/NE hybrid attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Fire Damage +30% for 1 turn to party, removes Master Mode
